## History

Fred Wright became secretly engaged to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), a fact revealed to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during the preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding. Following their engagement, Fred ultimately married [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in a ceremony at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Later, the couple welcomed the birth of their first child, a baby boy.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P38](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0038), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P39](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0039), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P41](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0041), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P42](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0042), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P47](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0047), +238 more_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Fred Wright and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) are romantically involved and secretly engaged to be married. Their hidden betrothal becomes known around the time of Miss Lavendar's wedding preparations. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continues to send updates about her life and engagement from home while their friends attend college.

- Romantically involved with — engaged / courting  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P16](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0016), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030), +3 more</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred Wright and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are connected as canvassing partners working together within their community circle. Their shared efforts align through local civic initiatives, such as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Young People's [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) projects.
